items.note: N1 correctly states the copy/gather/scatter/side-injection network giving (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) in three stages with restored scratch, and the method follows the eight-row schedule and the forward-inverse-forward composition. It omits h=100, the triple indexing, the neighbour rules, the net map (JV+RG)x and the explicit coefficients |S cap T| mod 2 and (|S cap T|-1)/2 (752-759). The cancellation is only alluded to, so the derivation is partial.

N2 states D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and edge operators D_vD_u^{-1}. Its method (stored = frame of logical, common frame commutes with pointwise gate) is the paper's invariant argument at 804-817. The per-route form eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1} is only paraphrased as 'only the endpoint frames matter'.

N3.1 and N3.2 correctly give the comparable labels, the only decreasing edges (central 3->4, loss h) and L/N = 100/539 and 101/539. But the budget sum|Delta dim| = Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich (1003-1006) is replaced by a vague 'below W·m'. The derivation lacks the orthogonality of neighbouring triple lines, the telescoping of signed changes (1066-1071) and the orthonormal-basis argument over F_2.

N4 states the endpoint identity M_sink(rho(w)) - M_source(w) = I_m and s_b < W_b m, and N4.1 gives the deficit N-2L_b (equivalent to s_b = W_b m - N + 2L_b). The projection assignment and rank = dimension change follow 1156-1161. The N exceptional source edges of rank one (2P_{U_a}, 1162-1165), which turn -2N into -N, are not mentioned.

The kernels aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector, s_c < W_c m and telescoping to C^{⊗m} are right. The route (weight additive mod 4, odd weight of norm-one vectors, C=iZC^{-1}Z on the 27 coordinates) matches 1232-1314. The frame is given only as the diagonal phase, without the H^{⊗m} conjugation of 1193, and s_c = W_c m - 2N + 2L_c is absent. The Hadamard step turning the character into the translation X_v (1254-1257) is missing.

The plan has L/N < 1/2, the deficit N-2L_b > 0, s_c < W_c m, and N6's 'deficits exceed 20·2^{-50} so s/W < m^tau, tau = 1-2^{-50}'. It never gives the values of eta_b and eta_c, the bound log m < 20, or the inequality m^{1-2^{-50}} > m(1-20·2^{-50}) (1332-1338) that converts the deficit into the exponent.

T1 and T2 follow the paper's proofs: aligned streams after a digit split, row split r=Wg+w, cut at Q-a and re-merge, unit multiplication by increasing pieces. T2's statement drops the hypothesis that the offset be preparable in b^{O(1)} time (566), on which the O(V) bound depends.

The plan gives the factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2 with lower triangular factors and a partial permutation with a ones, and the pivot elimination (topmost row, rightmost entry). It has the conjugation order of the triangular transforms and one interchange per pivot via D_j<-D_j+H_i, swap, D_j<-H_i-D_j. All of this matches 1375-1446.

The plan states the O(Ve^tau) interchange for e=m^k with a row field divisible by W^k. It carries the paper's route: cyclic row split into W role streams, Phi_{A_e} on each edge by recursive interchanges, H<-H+D on every row, the three shears, F_k <= (s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with the geometric sum, and the parking-stack schedule at O(V) per node.

C1 states (p,h,g,d,z)->(p,d,g,h,z) in O(Vu^tau). The substeps follow 1649-1734: top rho digits joined into a row field of range at least W^k, padding to a multiple of W^k, a base-m decomposition with a geometric sum, and binary-to-[q^e] padding.

The route matches 1852-1931: conjugate by P_M, slots of f chunks, row additions, s_c forward children of size e/m, inverse children via -iZCZ, and H_0^{⊗D} = b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D. L1's own statement loosely speaks of 'each of the s_c residual-basis slots', where the paper has rho_edge slot children per edge and s_c calls over the whole invocation (1880-1882, 1904-1906).

The plan covers the eight packed rotations as single cyclic shifts and the bad set defined by guards outside [10, 2^{K-1}-11]. It gives the union bound 80(f-1)2^{-K}, the repair by stable radix sort on destination rank, the separate top-position XOR and the O(V(L^tau+1)) cost, all as in 2013-2207. One minor misdescription of the composed cycle is listed under errors.

The node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)) with s children of volume V/W, the rows from the first q_0 chunks padded to W^{k_0}, the recurrence F(e) <= (s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) and the base-m pieces giving O(d^{lambda'}) are all present. L2.3 claims the recurrence sums to O(e^lambda). It omits the cutoff e < d^beta, K <= e^{c/beta} and the leaf contribution O(e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}) (2403-2427), which is why lambda' must exceed sigma+beta(1-sigma).

L states the layer on D <= d chunks in O(Vd^{lambda'}) with one final truncation. L3 gives Delta = ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}), A(e) <= sA(e/m)+E, the p+Delta and Delta+3 widths and epsilon C_1 < 1, and L4.2 the sqrt2·2^{-p} error. This matches 2479-2586 and 2686-2757; K = floor(d^c) is not restated in L.

The plan covers character cancellation by the shift t/2^{v+1}, decimation in frequency and bit-reversed storage B_tF_t^- with the reverse procedure F_t^+B_t^{-1}. It has the layout L (prefix moves, at most Dq-1 chunk exchanges), one simultaneous layer per round, the monomial by split and merge, the error sqrt2·ell·2^{-p} and the cost O(Tp[dK+pK^{tau-1}+ell d^{lambda'}]), all as in the paper.

The route matches 3233-3365: evaluation at B_0 = 2^{4p}, 4pr-bit magnitudes, four products with signs restored, centered residues since |h_j| < B_0/2, and negacyclic reduction. The statement says the polynomials are 'multiplied exactly ... and truncating' without saying that the output is Q_p(fg/r), normalized by r.

H states M_r(f,g) = (f*g)/T with error below sqrt2·M(3ell+1)2^{-p} and the stated cost. H5 and H6 follow the paper: retained LB order, products, opposite transform, exact scale by M, and the 3delta+eta error. The motivation reproduces P(LBu,LBv) = LB·P(u,v).

I1 states P_sF_s = 2^{2alpha^2} B_0 P_t F_t A with contractions, error below p^2 and time O(tp^{3/2+delta}alpha) under t/s-1 > p/alpha^4. The proof steps (S,T,C,D, ||N-I|| < 1/2, left inverse DN^{-1}C) match 3577-3642. I2 gives the tensor identity, O(dTp^{3/2+delta}alpha) and O(Tp d^2(1+ell^tau)) with the axis-exposure mechanism.

Both identities are stated exactly. The proofs follow the paper: coefficient comparison with the period-t_i chirp, and the dilation substitution F^+R_c = R_c^{-1}F^+ giving RF^+R = F^+, followed by the normalized convolution rule.

The exponents, sizes, alpha, gamma = o(b), the prime-interval lemma with log x > 8d, gcd = 1, Bernoulli for T/2 < S < T and the trial-division search all match 4007-4171. A2 leaves eta undefined (eta = 1/(4d), 4092) and states the separation as theta_i > eta, omitting the needed alpha^4 theta_i > p (4149).

The plan states Phi: x -> prod x_i^{mu_i}, mu_i = P_i^{-1} mod s_i, as a convolution-preserving isomorphism implemented by prefix-controlled cyclic shifts, with O(d^2) chunk moves and cost O(Tp d^2(1+ell^tau)). The explicit triangular formula b_i (4228) is only described as 'axis i depends only on lower-index digits'.
Well-definedness (zeta y)^r = 1, the diagonal isomorphism, the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h = zeta^j and untwisting all match 4303-4319. A6.1 gives the computed twist with 2·2^{-p} approximations.

The source transform (A, chirp transform, B_0, scale 2^gamma), its exact counterpart RF_s, the conjugated opposite procedure and the step list (Phi, two transforms, product, opposite transform, scales S and 2^{2b+4}S, rounding, Phi^{-1}, carries) match 4456-4544. The digit scale 2^{-b-2} is not stated.

Linear and bilinear contraction error propagation, E_s = 9·2^gamma TL, the cancellation G(U·V_1) = (u*v)/S^2 with error (3E_s+2)h_p, the final bound 448b·2^{-b+gamma} <= 448b·2^{-3b/4} < 1/2 and the carry invariant all match the paper. E_w = S(3E_s+2) is implicit.

The normalized cost table, the seven margins, the minimum g_2 = 2^{-181} = 2kappa, absorption of log factors into p^kappa, the bound O(Tp·p^{1-kappa}) and the schoolbook cutoff match 4815-4995. The individual table entries are not listed.
R relies on 'nlogn-conjecture', but no step explains that one machine with liminf T(n)/(n lg n) = 0 refutes the eventual lower bound, or that the bound gives limit zero.

errors.says: The method composes two three-cycles on the parity pairs (u,w) 'into a transposition'.
errors.paper: The first four operations induce (00 01 10) and the last four (01 10 11); together they give (00 10)(01 11), a product of two transpositions that flips the parity of u and fixes w.

errors.says: With a = s/W < m^lambda the recurrence F(e) <= (s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) sums to O(e^lambda).
errors.paper: Only the internal costs sum to O(e^lambda), using K <= e^{c/beta} at internal nodes and a <= m^sigma. Recursion stops at e < d^beta, and the leaves add O(e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}), which is why lambda' > max{lambda, sigma+beta(1-sigma)}.

errors.says: The plan applies 'the f-fold forward child on each of the s_c residual-basis slots'.
errors.paper: Each edge applies (C^{eps_h})^{⊗f} to slot h for 1 <= h <= rho_edge. Summing the residual dimensions over the network gives s_c child calls in all; there are only m slots.

errors.says: It describes the phase frames as i^{wt(P_U x) mod 4}.
errors.paper: The frame is C_U = H^{⊗m} diag_x(i^{q_U(x)}) H^{⊗m}. The Hadamard conjugation is what turns each character (-1)^{v·x} into the translation X_v, so that the edge change becomes aI+bX_v.

errors.says: The labels make 'the total dimension change over the edges of a network with W wires below W·m'.
errors.paper: The exact budget is sum|Delta dim| = Wm-2N+2L with L = Ich. The bit interface then adds N source ranks, so s_b = W_b m - N + 2L_b, and the saving needs L < N/2, not merely a budget below Wm.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound: one fixed exchange network with frames and nested labels, the bit interface feeding the power-width interchange and its recurrence, the complex interface feeding the phase-frame layer, then the transforms, resampling, chirp, assembly, recovery and cost table. It thins out at the central saving's arithmetic. The budget Wm-2N+2L, L = Ich, the rank-one source exceptions and the eta / log m < 20 step to tau = 1-2^{-50} appear only as quoted conclusions (N3.2, N4.1, N6). The layer recurrence (L2.3) drops its leaf term.

steps.note: The exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with restored scratch is stated. The defining data h=100, the triples in T^3, N = binom(h,3)^3 and m = h^3 never appear, so the network is not pinned down.
A common frame commutes with a pointwise gate, giving D_out S D_in^{-1}, and edges cost D_vD_u^{-1}.
Nondegenerate subspaces of the m-dimensional F^{⊗3}, comparable labels on every edge, and the only decreasing edges central 3->4, each losing h.
N4's method states that edge differences are projections onto residuals whose rank is the dimension change. The N rank-one source exceptions (2P_{U_a}) are not mentioned.
Only the deficit N-2L_b (equivalent to s_b = W_b m - N + 2L_b) appears, as a quote. The budget sum|Delta dim| = Wm-2N+2L and L = Ich are absent, so the 'hence' is not reconstructed.
L/N = 100/539 and 101/539 are below 1/2, giving the deficit N-2L_b > 0 and s < Wm.
M_sink(rho(w)) - M_source(w) = I_m on every role (P_{U_a^perp} - (-P_{U_a}) for X_a), giving H<-H+D on every row.
A=E_1 Pi E_2, exactly a interchanges plus O(V) per rank-a edge, and s child calls per node.
s calls on volume V/W give F_k <= (s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), and s/W < m^tau with tau = 1-2^{-50} from deficits above 20·2^{-50} gives O(e^tau). The bound log m < 20 used in the exponent step is not stated.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the mechanism of the saving: frames, nested labels with losses only on the central return, rank equal to dimension change, L/N < 1/2, the identity endpoint shear, rank-many recursive interchanges and the recurrence with tau = 1-2^{-50}. It does not pin down the network's parameters (h=100, triples, N, m). The dimension budget Wm-2N+2L with L = Ich, and the N rank-one source edges that make s_b = W_b m - N + 2L_b, are not reconstructed; only the resulting deficit is quoted.
